steps.title: Verify Target Environment and Build Dependencies
steps.description: Validated Temurin 17, Gradle 8.5, AGP 8.3.2, Java 8 source/target compatibility, ZXing core, and Tesseract native OCR libraries.

steps.title: Configure Package and Application Metadata
steps.description: Confirmed package com.boxstockmanager.app and app_id app_6b0950adce5ab across configuration manifests.

steps.title: Create Scan Log Data Model
steps.description: Implemented ScanLogItem Java class to encapsulate scan log records including timestamp, source, barcode, and full raw OCR text.

steps.title: Upgrade SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Bumped database version to 3 and added scan_log table migration with support for inserting, retrieving, filtering, auto-capping to 200 newest entries, and clearing logs.

steps.title: Add Decoded QR Raw Payload Support to Scanner Model
steps.description: Added rawDecodedText property to ProductScannerResult to store complete decoded QR code payloads without truncation.

steps.title: Update ZXing QR Decoder Pipeline
steps.description: Updated OcrScannerHelper to capture and store the complete raw text payload from ZXing QR decoding before parsing fields.

steps.title: Integrate Complete QR Text Logging in Main Activity
steps.description: Updated MainActivity scan result handler to prioritize complete decoded QR payloads for persistent Scan Log storage and clipboard copying.

steps.title: Implement Scan Log Adapter and Copy to Clipboard
steps.description: Built ScanLogAdapter to render scan items and added tap-to-copy functionality to copy full scanned text to system clipboard with Toast feedback.

steps.title: Add Clear Log Confirmation Dialog and State Sync
steps.description: Implemented clear log confirmation modal dialog that clears SQLite scan log records and updates the History UI immediately.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Compiling and building final Android APK with full QR payload retention in scan logs.
